title: CLAW Task Assign
description: Cross-node agent-to-agent task delegation (cascades, handoffs, wave assignments). Fire-and-forget core NATS, not JetStream: a target only receives it if it is subscribed at publish time (see make -C pmoves nats-agent-inbox). Payload shape documented in .claude/context/nats-subjects.md 'CLAW Agent Delegation Subjects'. Command-class: field bounds and repo-relative paths are enforced here because a receiver acts on this payload; `from` is a claim, not an authenticated identity.

from.description: Delegating agent or node identity as claimed by the sender (e.g. pmoves-4090, 5090-claude). Not authenticated; never use it for authorization.

to.description: Target agent or node identity expected to pick up the task

task.description: Short task or lane identifier (e.g. cascade-wave-B); no spaces or path/shell metacharacters

files_released.description: Repo-relative paths the sender has released for the target to edit. No leading slash or backslash, no drive letter, no '..' segment.

after_pr.description: PR numbers that must land before the target starts

note.description: Free-form human-readable context for the target
